name.description: Name of the SLA. Property behavior: required for create operations.

period.description: Reporting period of the SLA. Possible values: 0 - daily; 1 - weekly; 2 - monthly; 3 - quarterly; 4 - annually. Property behavior: required for create operations.

slo.description: Minimum acceptable Service Level Objective expressed as a percent. If the Service Level Indicator (SLI) drops lower, the SLA is considered to be in problem/unfulfilled state. Possible values: 0-100 (up to 4 fractional digits). Property behavior: required for create operations.

effective_date.description: Effective date of the SLA. Possible values: date timestamp in UTC.

timezone.description: Reporting time zone, for example: Europe/London, UTC. For the full list of supported time zones please refer to PHP documentation. Property behavior: required for create operations.

status.description: Status of the SLA. Possible values: 0 - (default) disabled SLA; 1 - enabled SLA.

service_tags.description: SLA service tags to be created for the SLA. Property behavior: required.

schedule.description: SLA schedule to be created for the SLA. Specifying an empty parameter will be interpreted as a 24x7 schedule. Default: 24x7 schedule.

excluded_downtimes.description: SLA excluded downtimes to be created for the SLA.

slaSchedule.description: SLA schedule object. Defines periods where the connected service(s) are scheduled to be in working order.

period_from.description: Starting time of the recurrent weekly period of time (inclusive). Possible values: number of seconds (counting from Sunday). Property behavior: required.

period_to.description: Ending time of the recurrent weekly period of time (exclusive). Possible values: number of seconds (counting from Sunday). Property behavior: required.

slaExcludedDowntime.description: SLA excluded downtime object. Defines periods where the connected service(s) are scheduled to be out of working order, without affecting SLI, e.g., undergoing planned maintenance.

name.description: Name of the excluded downtime. Property behavior: required.

period_from.description: Starting time of the excluded downtime (inclusive). Possible values: timestamp. Property behavior: required.

period_to.description: Ending time of the excluded downtime (exclusive). Possible values: timestamp. Property behavior: required.

slaServiceTag.description: SLA service tag object. Links services to include in the calculations for the SLA.

tag.description: SLA service tag name. Property behavior: required.

operator.description: SLA service tag operator. Possible values: 0 - (default) Equals; 2 - Contains.
